prompts.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: transparent fish sprite for a refined Korean fishing game with a tranquil watercolor pond background. Create one single fish, complete full body in strict LEFT-facing lateral side view (mouth on left, tail on right), near horizontal, all fins visible and contained. The image should be a highly realistic natural-history field-guide painted illustration, approximately 85% realistic biology and 15% soft hand-painted edges. Lifelike anatomy, subtle natural material texture and believable soft daylight volume. Not a cartoon, not vector clipart, not a toy, no exaggerated eye, no smiles. No water, scenery, pedestal, cast shadow, label, text, border, hooks, blood or extra fish. Truly transparent background. Wide horizontal composition with fish centered and comfortably isolated, about 88% of canvas width; leave transparent margin around ALL fins and barbels. Mouth should be near the middle of the image height. Fine, quiet detail readable at 150 to 300px. Natural muted colors compatible with pale sage-green water; clear silhouette, delicate translucent fin rays. This is an original generated game illustration, not an actual photograph. Subject: a wild bronze-silver crucian carp, Carassius auratus, NOT an ornamental fancy goldfish. A deep, laterally compressed oval body, small proportionate dark eye with a tiny realistic highlight, small terminal mouth with NO BARBELS. Olive-gray dorsal area, pearly silver and muted warm bronze orderly overlapping scales, ivory-silver lower belly, long dorsal fin held naturally open, gently forked gray-olive tail. Clearly deeper-bodied and more compact than a common carp. Quiet museum-quality realism, no heavy watercolor washes covering the scales.
